ui-present.ac.cannotApply: this device cannot apply it (see above)
ui-present.ac.confirm: Restarting now interrupts: {list}. The history stays; after the restart the conversation goes on, but the interrupted turn is not redone by itself.
ui-present.ac.explainClaude: Enter Claude Code's own compaction window (--autocompact, {range}), as is: Claude starts compacting at the window minus what it keeps for the summary, and reports the actual trigger point. Applies to every conversation of this profile.
ui-present.ac.explainCodex: Enter Codex's auto-compact limit (model_auto_compact_token_limit, {range}). Empty: Codex compacts at 90% of the model's context window (the ring estimates by this rule, ≈); a limit above 90% also counts as 90%. Applies to every conversation of this profile.
ui-present.ac.explainOther: {agent}'s compaction point cannot be set per profile.
ui-present.ac.idle: idle, restarting by itself right away
ui-present.ac.noneOnline: No AI online: it starts with the new value from the next message
